body:
**Darkweb:** Weekly @nq.young brief, Jan 1→5: 1,000 followers (+2), 4 feed reels this week.
One change: put the payoff car in the first 2 seconds and name it in the caption.

**Darkweb relay (Oski, Jan 5):** IG reel from @zoom.maker — **"STEAL THIS RAPID ZOOM"** tutorial (900 likes / 10 comments). https://www.instagram.com/reel/AAA111/

Caption hook: "The first 2 seconds decide everything." Ten clips, radial blur, a red car in the final montage.

Edit-style reference only, no new directive. Obvious test case: open on a Ferrari.

**Darkweb relay (Oski, Jan 5):** IG reel from @sound.guy (50,000 followers) — **"MY FAVOURITE SFX"** (20,000 likes / 30,000 comments). https://www.instagram.com/reel/BBB222/

Six sound effects with waveforms. The pack is gated behind commenting "SOUND" — not chased.

**Darkweb relay (Oski, Jan 5):** IG reel from @desk.tool — **DeskThing**, a desktop organizer for Windows (5,000 likes / 100 comments). https://www.instagram.com/reel/CCC333/

Tool reference only, no new directive.

**Darkweb relay (Oski, Jan 5): his saved collection, 2 posts.**

1. @grid.editor (reel) — four-quadrant split-screen of one speaker, 1,200 likes / 50 comments. https://www.instagram.com/reel/DDD444/

2. @grid.editor (reel) — the same split-screen, part 2. https://www.instagram.com/reel/EEE555/?igsh=abc
**Claude:** Thanks. Omarie picked one to try: the @zoom.maker rapid zoom. Nothing posts until he does.

**Darkweb relay (Oski, Jan 5):** YouTube — **"Monochrome car teaser in film grain"** by Some Channel (10K subs, 40K views). https://youtube.com/watch?v=FFF666

A black-and-white car montage.
**Darkweb relay (Oski, Dec 1):** IG reel from @old.post — rapid zoom again (5 likes / 1 comments). https://www.instagram.com/reel/OLD000/
